description: This Rust source file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with the Kuksa data broker. It includes command parsing, metadata handling, connection management, and subscription features, along with auto-completion and display formatting.

classes.name: CliCompleter
classes.description: Implements command-line auto-completion based on metadata entries, providing command and parameter suggestions.

classes.name: PathPart
classes.description: Represents a node in the hierarchical path tree used for command auto-completion.

classes.name: DisplayDataType
classes.description: Wrapper for displaying DataType enum values.

classes.name: DisplayEntryType
classes.description: Wrapper for displaying EntryType enum values.

classes.name: DisplayDatapoint
classes.description: Formats and displays a datapoint value for CLI output.

methods.name: kuksa_main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that initializes the CLI, manages connection, command parsing, and event loop.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for a specific command.

methods.name: from_metadata
methods.description: Constructs a CLI completer tree from metadata entries.

methods.name: complete_entry_path
methods.description: Provides command-line completion suggestions for hierarchical paths based on current input.
